instruction: Change my Chrome browser's default search engine back to Google.

metadata.explanation: Task asks to restore Google as the default search engine. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter to check current setting, then match_in_list to verify it matches Google.
metadata.verification: Leverages existing Chrome settings getter. Same difficulty as original task - requires navigating Chrome settings interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file using the right JSON path (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric function match_in_list appropriately checks if the extracted search engine name is in the expected list
Expected values include both "Google" and "google" to handle potential case variations in Chrome settings
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement from the instruction (default search engine is Google)
The verification logic will work correctly at runtime - getter can access the state, metric can compare correctly
